column4: Works well but pricey for a larger business
column7: Matyas ハンガリーのOnline Business Director (former) レジャー、旅行、観光, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Works well but pricey for a larger business"
column8: It has tons of integrations with OTA's and many additional features. Their support and the content they publish are also great.
column9: Taking a percentage fee after each booking with no maximum amount per month is honestly not something I can agree on in principle, especially considering that in our plan we paid around 3.5% after every booking done through our own website, plus a fixed fee of EUR .50 per each ticket sold, plus monthly fee, plus cancellation fees sometimes, plus there was even a fee for receiving bookings from OTA's -- the total of this was around 5 to 7 percent of our total revenue that we paid in fees per month. This may be fine for a small business just starting out with yearly online bookings under 50k, but it amounts to a ton per month if you have a higher volume of bookings. I don't think it's reasonable to pay this much for a reservation system at a higher volume. This 5 to 7 percent amounts to a much higher percent of the profit margin itself. For our business, we found that there are other products that cost way less and have similar or even better functionality.

column9: Die Scan-Funktion der Regiondo App ist leider seit mehr als 1 Jahr nicht mehr zuverlässig und trotz mehrfachem Kontakt mit dem Support kann keine Lösung gefunden werden.
